faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.questionTrial: How does the free trial work?
faq.answerTrial: Anyone can signup for the 14-day free trial to test Hyvor Blogs. No credit card required. All features are available during the trial. After the trial, you can upgrade to a paid plan to continue using Hyvor Blogs.
faq.questionPlanChange: Can I upgrade or downgrade my plan later?
faq.answerPlanChange: Yes. You can change your plan anytime from your console billing settings.
faq.questionPayment: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.answerPayment: We accept all major credit and debit cards through our payment processor. Enterprise customers can also pay by invoice and bank transfer. See our billing documentation for more details.
faq.questionOverage: What happens if I reach my plan limits?
faq.answerOverage: We'll notify you as you approach a limit such as team members, media storage, or AI usage. Your blog keeps running normally, and you can upgrade to a higher plan at any time to raise the limits.
faq.answerEnterprise: Enterprise plans are custom-priced around your usage, the limits you need, and your support requirements. Contact our sales team for a quote.
faq.questionThemes: Do I have to pay for themes?
faq.answerThemes: No, all official themes are free and open-source. They can be easily installed on your blog with a few clicks.
faq.answerDiscounts: You get 2-months off if you pay annually. In addition, we provide a 10% discount for non-profit organizations and early-stage startups. Contact us via live chat to get the coupon.
faq.questionOwnership: Who owns the content I write?
faq.answerOwnership: You own everything you write. You decide what to do with your content. You can export your content anytime and move to another platform.
faq.answerLimits: No, we don't limit the number of pageviews or bandwidth. Due to extensive caching and optimizations, we can handle a large number of pageviews without any issues.
faq.answerHyvorTalk: Yes. Every Hyvor Blogs plan comes with a complimentary Hyvor Talk license, so you can add comments to your blog for free. Each plan includes a monthly credit allowance, and higher plans include more credits.
faq.answerHyvorPost: Yes. Every plan comes with a complimentary Hyvor Post license for sending newsletters to your subscribers. Each plan includes a monthly email allowance that grows with your plan.
faq.questionMoreLimits: What if I need further limits on Hyvor Talk or Post?
faq.answerMoreLimits: You have two options: upgrade your Hyvor Blogs plan, or start a separate Hyvor Talk or Hyvor Post subscription. If you start a separate subscription, your overall allowance becomes the sum of the complimentary allowance from Hyvor Blogs and the allowance from that subscription.
faq.answerAiCost: Yes. AI features such as the AI Agent are included from the Starter plan onward, with no separate charge. Higher plans include more monthly AI usage.
faq.answerMultipleBlogs: Yes. From the Starter plan onward you can have multiple blogs under a single organization. The Personal plan is limited to one blog.
faq.questionTeamMembers: Can I add more team members?
faq.answerTeamMembers: Each plan has a team member limit, which is the total number of unique team members allowed across all the blogs of your organization. To add more, upgrade to a plan with a higher limit.
faq.answerCustomDomains: Yes, custom domains are included on every plan. Hyvor Blogs automatically generates a TLS certificate for your domain with Let's Encrypt, or you can bring your own TLS certificate.
